package myce

// Compiled, unmodified, against both production source trees by upgrade-compat.py.
// Only hardware and the service manager are synthetic; queue persistence, HTTP,
// worker startup, inventory discovery and installer serialization are real.
import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"testing/fstest"
	"time"
)

func TestUpgradeCompatProcess(t *testing.T) {
	mode := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_MODE")
	if mode == "" {
		t.Skip("process fixture")
	}
	root := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_ROOT")
	ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer cancel()
	switch mode {
	case "queue", "queue-work":
		upgradeQueue(t, ctx, root)
	case "worker":
		upgradeWorker(t, ctx, root)
	case "install":
		upgradeInstall(t, ctx, root)
	default:
		t.Fatal("unknown fixture mode")
	}
}

type upgradeClock struct{}

func (upgradeClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 11, 5, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

func upgradeQueue(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, root string) {
	var clock Clock = upgradeClock{}
	work := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_MODE") == "queue-work"
	if work {
		clock = RealClock{}
		// Execution needs real progress storage; the status-only cases never
		// needed to create this root before exercising a worker's first job.
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "checkpoints"), 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	q, err := Open(filepath.Join(root, "state", "queue.db"), filepath.Join(root, "checkpoints"), clock)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer q.Close()
	now := q.clock.Now()
	q.s.WorkObservations = map[string]WorkObservation{}
	q.s.StorageObservations = map[string]StorageObservation{}
	// Seed disposable in-process state, never a live database. One ordinary queue
	// transaction writes the fixture, avoiding thousands of quadratic submissions.
	for i := 0; i < 6286; i++ {
		id := fmt.Sprintf("retained-%05d", i)
		s := Spec{Name: id, Project: "upgrade-compat", Priority: "experiment"}
		s.Run.Command = []string{"echo", "retained"}
		q.s.Jobs[id] = &Job{ID: id, Spec: s, State: "succeeded", Attempt: 1, Queued: now, FinishedAt: &now, ReleaseConfirmed: true}
	}
	for i := 0; i < 1655; i++ {
		id := fmt.Sprintf("curve-%04d", i)
		q.s.WorkObservations[id] = WorkObservation{Key: ObservationKey{Work: id, Hardware: strings.Repeat("hardware", 16), Configuration: strings.Repeat("config", 16)}, Samples: 10, Units: 100, Seconds: 20, RecordedAt: now}
	}
	for i := 0; i < 1384; i++ {
		q.s.StorageObservations[fmt.Sprint(i)] = StorageObservation{}
	}
	if work {
		s := Spec{Name: "cadence-work", Project: "upgrade-compat", Priority: "experiment"}
		s.Run.Command = []string{"/bin/sh", "-c", "exit 0"}
		s.Needs.Platform.Required = []string{"cpu"}
		s.Needs.MemoryGB, s.Needs.CPUCores = 0.125, 1
		job, err := q.Submit(s)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "job-id"), []byte(job.ID), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := q.update(func() error { return nil }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	handler := API{Queue: q, Token: "upgrade-fixture"}.Handler()
	var mu sync.Mutex
	receipts := []map[string]any{}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "receipts.json"), []byte("[]"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	server := &http.Server{Handler: http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path != "/api/workers/checkin" {
			handler.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			return
		}
		body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 10<<20))
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		r.Body.Close()
		r.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(body)))
		capture := &upgradeResponse{ResponseWriter: w, status: 200}
		handler.ServeHTTP(capture, r)
		var request map[string]any
		_ = json.Unmarshal(body, &request)
		machine, _ := request["machine"].(map[string]any)
		inventory, _ := machine["tool_inventory"].(map[string]any)
		var reply map[string]any
		_ = json.Unmarshal(capture.body, &reply)
		offered := false
		if attempts, ok := reply["attempts"].([]any); ok {
			for _, raw := range attempts {
				if attempt, ok := raw.(map[string]any); ok && attempt["job"] != nil {
					offered = true
				}
			}
		}
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		receipts = append(receipts, map[string]any{
			"status": capture.status, "bytes": len(body), "inventory_keys": len(inventory),
			"hash": request["tool_inventory_hash"], "version": request["tool_inventory_version"],
			"session": machine["session"], "attempt_protocol": request["attempt_protocol"],
			"protocol": reply["tool_inventory_protocol"], "required": reply["tool_inventory_required"],
			"ack_hash": reply["tool_inventory_hash"], "ack_version": reply["tool_inventory_version"],
			"period": r.Header.Get("X-Myce-Checkin-Period"), "offered": offered, "recovering": request["recovering"],
		})
		data, _ := json.Marshal(receipts)
		tmp := filepath.Join(root, "receipts.tmp")
		if err := os.WriteFile(tmp, data, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			return
		}
		if err := os.Rename(tmp, filepath.Join(root, "receipts.json")); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}), ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second}
	address := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_LISTEN")
	if address == "" {
		address = "127.0.0.1:0"
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", address)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- server.Serve(listener) }()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "url"), []byte("http://"+listener.Addr().String()), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	<-ctx.Done()
	stop, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := server.Shutdown(stop); err != nil {
		server.Close()
		t.Error(err)
	}
	if err := <-done; err != http.ErrServerClosed {
		t.Error(err)
	}
}

type upgradeResponse struct {
	http.ResponseWriter
	status int
	body   []byte
}

func (w *upgradeResponse) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	w.body = append(w.body, data...)
	return w.ResponseWriter.Write(data)
}

func (w *upgradeResponse) WriteHeader(status int) {
	w.status = status
	w.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(status)
}

func upgradeWorker(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, root string) {
	// No native GPU, mounted-share discovery, daemon, or fleet authority is used.
	workerMountRoots = func(context.Context) ([]string, error) { return []string{"/"}, nil }
	workerDiskProbe = func(string) (DiskReading, error) {
		return DiskReading{Volume: "fixture", TotalBytes: 1 << 40, FreeBytes: 1 << 39}, nil
	}
	workerOwnerSignals = func(context.Context) OwnerSignals { return OwnerSignals{Power: "desktop"} }
	workerDeviceFaultSource = func() DeviceFaultSource { return nil }
	workerMemoryRSS = nil
	workerProcessMemory = nil
	workerLivenessCPU = nil
	extensionIdentityProbe = func() MachineProbe {
		return MachineProbe{Files: fstest.MapFS{}, Command: func(context.Context, string, ...string) ([]byte, error) { return []byte("fixture"), nil }}
	}
	m := Machine{ID: "compat-worker", HostID: "compat-host", GPU: "fake", FreeMemoryGB: 8, HostMemoryMeasured: true, CapabilityProfile: &CapabilityProfile{Version: 0, OS: runtime.GOOS, Arch: runtime.GOARCH, LogicalCPUs: 16, MemoryLayout: "separate", SystemMemoryBytes: 64 << 30}}
	for i := 0; i < 40; i++ {
		m.Environments = append(m.Environments, fmt.Sprintf("prepared-%064d", i))
	}
	devices := []MachineDevice{}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		id := fmt.Sprint(i)
		devices = append(devices, MachineDevice{ID: id, Platform: "fake", Identity: "fixture-" + id, Selector: id, Fingerprint: "fixture", MemoryMode: "fixed", TotalMemoryGB: 8, BudgetGB: 8, FreeMemoryGB: 8, MemoryMeasured: true})
	}
	m.Devices = devices
	w := Worker{Machine: m, StateDir: filepath.Join(root, "worker"), Client: Client{URL: os.Getenv("UPGRADE_QUEUE"), Token: "upgrade-fixture", HTTP: &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}}, Interval: 200 * time.Millisecond, HostMemorySource: func(context.Context) (float64, error) { return 60, nil }, InventoryProbe: func(context.Context) ([]MachineDevice, error) { return devices, nil }, CPUIsolationProbe: func(context.Context) error { return nil }}
	if path := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_CONFIG"); path != "" {
		c, err := ReadServiceConfig(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := c.ValidateInstall(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		w.StateDir = c.State
		w.FileCacheLimit = c.FileCacheBytes
		w.EnvironmentRoot = c.EnvironmentCache
		w.EnvironmentLimit = c.EnvironmentCacheBytes
		w.Machine.ID = c.Name
		w.Machine.HostID = c.HostID
	}
	if err := w.Run(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

type upgradeInactive int

func (upgradeInactive) Error() string   { return "fixture inactive" }
func (e upgradeInactive) ExitCode() int { return int(e) }
func upgradeInstall(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, root string) {
	c, err := PlanInstall("worker", root, "", filepath.Join(root, "nas"), os.Getenv("UPGRADE_QUEUE"), "compat-worker", Detection{OS: runtime.GOOS, Arch: runtime.GOARCH, Platform: "fake", MemoryMode: "fixed", MemoryGB: 8})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c.EnvironmentRoot = ""
	c.ModelRoot = ""
	c.Checkpoints = ""
	c.HostID = "compat-host"
	c.AllowDeviceless = true
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	manager := func(_ context.Context, name string, args ...string) ([]byte, error) {
		if name == "launchctl" {
			if len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "print" {
				return nil, upgradeInactive(113)
			}
			return nil, nil
		}
		if name != "systemctl" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected manager command %s", name)
		}
		if strings.Contains(strings.Join(args, " "), "is-active") {
			return nil, upgradeInactive(3)
		}
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err := Install(ctx, c, executable, "upgrade-fixture", manager); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "config-path"), []byte(c.Config), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
